business_problem: A dated Microsoft AX ERP was aging past support, slowed operations, kept Human Resources separate, and didn’t provide a Sales support tool. The company’s growth highlighted the need to modernize and integrate its business software solution.
solution_summary: A dated Microsoft AX ERP was aging past support, slowed operations, kept Human Resources separate, and didn’t provide a Sales support tool. The company’s growth highlighted the need to modernize and integrate its business software solution. For phase one, the company migrated operations to Dynamics 365 Finance, Project Operations, and Supply Chain Management, and added Sales. Phase two involved migrating from Talent to the integrated Dynamics 365 Human Resources. The latest piece of KJLC’s modernization effort involved an infrastructure migration. In 2023, the company moved from Dynamics 365 Talent to the latest Dynamics 365 Human Resources solution, which is now integrated into the finance and operations platform. The company was impressed by additional features the migration offered, such as the ability to make customizations, easy exports to Dataverse Azure Data Lake Storage , more reporting, and the visibility it gives to managers about their team’s training and performance.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Finance
solution_components.role: Handles budgeting, financial transactions, reporting, and approval flows on the shared ERP platform.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management
solution_components.role: Coordinates inventory, order, warehouse, and planning workflows with real-time supply-chain visibility.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Sales
solution_components.role: Provides the CRM and opportunity-management layer for account planning, seller coordination, and pipeline visibility.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Human Resources
solution_components.role: Keeps employee, training, and HR records synchronized with the wider business platform.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Project Operations
solution_components.role: Tracks project work breakdowns, engineering tasks, and execution details across the delivery lifecycle.

business_outcome: Tom Dockstader, Global IT Manager, Kurt J. Lesker Company
architecture_clues: HR, finance, supply chain, sales, and project data synchronize through the Dynamics 365 platform, while inventory and pricing information feed the ecommerce site and order activity flows back into the same operational system for reporting and fulfillment.

For phase one, the company migrated operations to Dynamics 365 Finance, Project Operations, and Supply Chain Management, and added Sales. Phase two involved migrating from Talent to the integrated Dynamics 365 Human Resources.

Once live, regular synchronization was established between the HR solution and the finance and operations platform for near-real-time data access. Dynamics 365 Finance processes core financial transactions, including multilevel consolidation, financial reporting, along with credit and collections across five operating entities and four subsidiaries. Supply Chain Management provides purchase requisitions with approval workflows, production processes for make-to-stock and make-to-order, inventory and warehouse management, and master planning. Project Operations manages work breakdowns and tasks for product engineering. To complete the solution, independent software vendors (ISVs) address specific business needs: Avalara for US tax, SK Global Treasury for bank integrations and credit card processing, Supply Chain Cloud to integrate small parcel shipping carriers, and Bluestar PLM for product lifecycle management. Says Dockstader, “Dynamics 365 provides the solid but flexible foundation for KJLC to grow our global business.”

The legacy system didn’t offer a way to segregate and manage inventory for specific uses, locations, or products; making it challenging to know exactly how much was on hand and if it was adequate for all incoming orders. Now, with Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, material purchases associated with specific orders or production sites can be aggregated for easy handling and supplier volume discounts. The new system reduces effort, confusion, and conflict, since everyone has what they need, where they need it, and it’s all tracked and visible to anyone who has required permissions.

With Dynamics 365 Sales, customer data is integrated across Finance and Supply Chain Management, giving everyone a 360-degree view of customers. KJLC also uses lead and opportunity management, providing visibility to sales being nurtured. With the integrated order process, Sales users have a complete view of in-progress orders to provide the best possible customer service. “In the past, somebody in sales would do something and then essentially the order went into a black box,” says Dockstader, “and nobody knew its status until the order was actually shipped.”
